newsitem.title: USA: Veronis to acquire T/SF for $145 mln.
newsitem.headline: Veronis to acquire T/SF for $145 mln.

text.p: T/SF Communications Corp said Friday that it has agreed to sell the company to VS&A Communications Partners II, an affiliate of Veronis Suhler & Associates Inc, a New York City investment banking and fund management firm in a deal valued at about $145 million.
The company said it would tender for its own shares at $40.25 per share, cash. Simultaneously, Veronis will acquire newly-issued shares of T/SF and provide financing for the share repurchase.
The company added that Fir Tree partners and its affiliates, major shareholders in T/SF, have agreed not to tender their shares and to continue as investors in T/SF.
The company said the transaction is contingent on 1.6 million shares being tendered, and that the offer is expected to begin no later that September 8. It will be open for 20 business days.
T/SF publishes trade and specialty publications, provides management services for trade shows, does trademark research, and provides pre-employment screening for the trucking industry.
